headline: R.P.P. Infra Projects Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: R.P.P. Infra Projects Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a material acquisition event requiring public disclosure of shareholding changes and offer obligations.
detail: R.P.P. Infra Projects Limited, a BSE/NSE-listed infrastructure company, has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition event. Regulation 31(4) requires that when a person (or persons acting in concert) acquires shares such that their aggregate holding crosses material thresholds (typically 25% for a general announcement and 35% for a mandatory open offer), or when a concert party arrangement is established, a formal disclosure must be filed with the exchange. The disclosure does not specify the acquiring party, acquisition price, or number of shares acquired; these details would typically be contained in the full Regulation 31(4) form filed separately with the stock exchanges and available on the NSE website.
